description: This file contains the implementation of a database driver class (ADODB_ibase) for Interbase/Firebird in a PHP database abstraction layer, including methods for connection management, SQL execution, transaction control, metadata retrieval, blob handling, and date formatting.

classes.name: ADODB_ibase
classes.description: Database driver class for Interbase, providing methods for connecting, executing SQL, transaction management, metadata retrieval, and blob handling.

classes.name: ADORecordset_ibase
classes.description: Recordset class for handling results from Interbase queries, including field info, fetching, and closing result resources.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Interbase database, setting date format configurations.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Persistent connection wrapper calling _connect.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns of a specified table.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the connected server, including dialect version.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Begins a transaction, managing internal transaction state.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: _Execute
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement and returns a result set or boolean, with optional logging support.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: &MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a given table.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Locks specific rows in a table for update (rudimentary implementation).

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a new generator (sequence) starting at a specified ID.

methods.name: DropSequence
methods.description: Deletes a generator (sequence).

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a new ID from a sequence, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Stub method, not used in this driver.

methods.name: _handleerror
methods.description: Retrieves and stores the last error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the numeric error code from the last error.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a SQL statement for execution.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with optional parameters, handling transactions and errors.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: _ConvertFieldType
methods.description: Converts database-specific field types to standard types for metadata purposes.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information about columns in a table.

methods.name: BlobEncode
methods.description: Encodes and stores a blob value in the database, returning a blob ID.

methods.name: BlobDecode
methods.description: Decodes a blob value, returning the raw data.

methods.name: _BlobDecode
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve and decode blob data.

methods.name: UpdateBlobFile
methods.description: Reads a file and updates a blob column with its contents.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a blob column with provided data, chunked if necessary.

methods.name: OldUpdateBlob
methods.description: Legacy method for updating blob data.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Formats a date string for SQL queries based on a format pattern.
